note: Multiply by 6: 3(x+1)-2(x-1) >= 6 -> x+5 >= 6 -> x >= 1. x=1 gives 1-0=1 >= 1, endpoint included.

a<0: opens down, always has solutions. a=0: -2x+1<0 solves x>1/2, so a=0 WORKS. 0<a<1: disc 4-4a>0. a=1: (x-1)^2, never <0. Full set is a<1 = A. C excludes a=0 and is correct only if the stem implicitly requires a quadratic (a!=0) - that is the whole A-vs-C dispute here.

value: all real a,b,c (inequality is unconditionally true)
note: Known sharp cyclic inequality; true for ALL reals. Numerically probed tight cases: (3,2,1) gives 196 vs 195; (2,1,0) gives 25 vs 24; a=b=c gives equality. No counterexample exists.
(x-1)(x-3)/((x-2)(x-4)) > 0. Sign chart on 1,2,3,4: +,-,+,-,+. All endpoints excluded (zeros of numerator fail strict >, zeros of denominator undefined).
At a=b=c the sum is 3/sqrt(2) ~ 2.121; infimum over positive reals is 2 (a->0, b=c). So the sum always exceeds sqrt(1.5). The classical result is >= 2, i.e. the stated <= sqrt(3/2) is never true.
(x+y+z)^2 = 1 + 2(xy+yz+zx) and xy+yz+zx <= x^2+y^2+z^2 = 1, attained at x=y=z=1/sqrt(3). Max is 1.

Difference = [(x+1)(x+2)-(x-1)(x-2)]/((x-2)(x+2)) = 6x/((x-2)(x+2)) >= 0. Critical -2,0,2; x=0 included (LHS=RHS test: 1/(-2)=-0.5 >= -1/2, equality). B has the right SHAPE but breakpoint -1/3 instead of 0; x=-0.2 satisfies (-0.364 >= -0.667) yet is outside B, so B is wrong. No option matches.
Rationalise: sum = (sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))/d + (sqrt(c)-sqrt(b))/d = (sqrt(c)-sqrt(a))/d with d = b-a = c-b = (c-a)/2. Gives 2(sqrt(c)-sqrt(a))/(c-a) = 2/(sqrt(a)+sqrt(c)).
Difference = 2x/((x+1)(x+2)) > 0. Sign chart on -2,-1,0. Test x=1: 0 > -1/3 TRUE, so 1 is a solution but lies in no option's second branch (A needs x>2). A is wrong; no option matches.

x>=2: x^2+x-4 >= 2 at x=2, true throughout. x<2: x^2-x >= 0 -> x<=0 or x>=1. Union: (-inf,0] U [1,inf). x=0.5 fails (1.75<2) so A wrong; x=1.5 works (2.75>=2) so B wrong; x=-0.5 works (2.75>=2) so C wrong.

Domain x>=1. LHS = 4/(sqrt(x+3)+sqrt(x-1)), decreasing; <1 iff sqrt(x+3)+sqrt(x-1) > 4, i.e. x > 13/4 (at x=3.25: 2.5-1.5 = 1 exactly). x=2 gives 2.236-1=1.236 which is NOT < 1, yet every option contains x=2. No option matches.
TWIN: A=B (byte-identical options). 2x+1>=7 -> x>=3; 2x+1<=-7 -> x<=-4. Endpoints included (|.|=7). TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). 3x-4>8 -> x>4; 3x-4<-8 -> x<-4/3. Strict both ends. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). 2x-3 = x+1 -> x=4; 2x-3 = -(x+1) -> 3x=2 -> x=2/3. Both verify. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=C (identical). -1 < |x|-2 < 1 -> 1 < |x| < 3. All endpoints strict. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). -4 <= x+3 <= 4 -> -7 <= x <= 1; both endpoints give |.|=4, included. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=C (identical). 3x+4=2 -> x=-2/3; 3x+4=-2 -> x=-2. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.

g(x)=|x+1|-|x-2| equals -3 for x<-1, 2x-1 on [-1,2), 3 for x>=2. g<=2 gives x<-1 (all), and -1<=x<=3/2. Union (-inf, 3/2]. x=1 satisfies (g=1<=2) but is outside A; x=3 fails (g=3>2) so C is wrong. No option matches.
TWIN: A=D (identical). 5x-3>=12 -> x>=3; 5x-3<=-12 -> x<=-9/5. Endpoints included. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). Both sides non-negative so squaring is valid: 3x^2-10x-8 > 0 -> 3(x-4)(x+2/3) > 0. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=C (identical). Square: x^2+8x+16 >= 4x^2-4x+1 -> x^2-4x-5 <= 0 -> (x-5)(x+1) <= 0. Endpoints give equality of moduli, included. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). -c < ax+b < c -> -b-c < ax < -b+c; dividing by a>0 preserves order. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=D (identical). x<2: 6-2x=6 -> x=0 (valid). 2<=x<=4: LHS=2, never 6. x>4: 2x-6=6 -> x=6 (valid). TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.
TWIN: A=C=D (all three identical). x<0: 3-2x>5 -> x<-1. 0<=x<=3: LHS=3, fails. x>3: 2x-3>5 -> x>4. THREE SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.

TWIN: A=D ([-2,1]) but both are WRONG. Since (x+2)+(x-1) = 2x+1, |u|+|v|=|u+v| iff uv>=0, i.e. (x+2)(x-1)>=0 -> x<=-2 or x>=1. Check x=0: 2+1=3 vs |1|=1, fails (so [-2,1] is wrong); x=2: 4+1=5=|5|, holds.
Only requirement is |x-2|-3 != 0 -> x != 5 and x != -1. Denominator may be negative; that is fine for a real-valued function.
TWIN: A=D (identical). f(x)=|x-a|+|x-b| has minimum b-a on [a,b] and slope -2/+2 outside; c > b-a so the level c is met once on each outer ray. TWO SIMULTANEOUSLY-TRUE OPTIONS.

Domain (x-2)(x-3)>=0 -> x<=2 or x>=3; RHS>=0 needs x>=2; so candidates {2} U [3,inf). Squaring gives x>=2, satisfied throughout. x=6 works (sqrt(12)=3.46 <= 4) but lies in no option; x=2.5 is outside the domain so A and C are wrong; x=5 works so D is wrong. No option matches.

(x-3)(x+2)/(x-5) < 0. Test x=-3: 6/-8 = -0.75 < 0 (true); x=0: -6/-5 = 1.2 > 0 (false); x=4: 6/-1 = -6 < 0 (true); x=6: 24 > 0 (false). The branch (-inf,-2) is unbounded, so the integer count is infinite - the question as stated has no finite answer. Only (3,5) is bounded and contributes exactly ONE integer (4), matching none of 4/5/6/7.

Domain x>=4. LHS increasing; equals 3 exactly at x=5 (2+1=3). So LHS<3 iff 4 <= x < 5. x=6 gives 2.236+1.414 = 3.65 > 3 and is NOT a solution, yet A, B and C all contain it. x=4 IS included (1.732<3), so C is wrong on the left endpoint too. No option matches.

x<-1: nonneg/negative <= 0 < 1, all true. x>-1: |x-2| <= x+1; for x>=2 always true, for -1<x<2 gives 2-x <= x+1 -> x >= 1/2. Union (-inf,-1) U [1/2,inf). x=10 works (8/11 <= 1) but option C caps at 3, so C is wrong. No option matches.

TWIN: A=B (identical). Subtract 1: (3-x)/((x-1)(x-3)) >= 0, and for x != 3 this is -1/(x-1) >= 0 -> x < 1. x=3 is undefined; x=5 gives 6/8 = 0.75 which is NOT >= 1, so the (3,inf) branch in A/B is wrong. x=2 gives 0/(-1) = 0, not >= 1, so D is wrong. No option matches.

(x+2)(x-1)/((x+2)(x-3)); x=-2 makes BOTH zero so it is a hole, excluded from the domain. Elsewhere (x-1)/(x-3) <= 0 -> 1 <= x < 3. x=-3 gives 4/6 = +0.67 (not <=0) so D is wrong; x=0 gives -2/-6 = +0.33 so B and C are wrong; x=-2 is undefined and x=-1 gives -2/-4 = +0.5 so A is wrong. No option matches.
